rights.readBefore: Read before you quote an Article
rights.note.articlesection: An Article is the big promise. A section is the exact procedure. The Constitution has Articles; laws such as the BNSS and BNS have sections. Police often talk in sections. You can use both.
rights.note.calm: Say it calmly and politely. Quoting an Article does not give you the power to stop the police. Your rights are protected afterwards by the Magistrate and courts. Use words only. Never use force.
